composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-111, "+24V DC DISTRIBUTION") is the master +24V DC load schedule for the vessel — three physical panels (AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS, FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS, EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY/EMERGENCY PANEL/GMDSS) each listing breaker rows Q#/QE#/CB# with rating and named load. Every row names one piece of equipment or one lighting/system circuit that is served by that panel via that breaker — evidence is the direct breaker-symbol-to-label line drawn on each row. The panels themselves (bus structure, breaker numbering, service-supply fuses F5-F8/SW6-9, CT7/CT8/CT9/CT10 monitoring taps, T/S E terminal block) are infrastructure belonging to 640-dc-distribution, not to any single load.

facts: Sheet GMMS 108'-111 '+24V DC DISTRIBUTION' documents three physical panel groups: AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS (Q1-Q54 across two columns), FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS (Q1-Q20, QE1-QE4), and EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY / EMERGENCY PANEL / GMDSS (QE1-QE8, CB5-CB8).

Left-edge '24V SERVICE SUPPLY' feed: F5 100A / F6 200A fuses feed switches SW6/SW7 (rated 70A/95A shown on switch symbols) which tie into the AFT panel bus; a separate branch F7 60A -> SW8 -> SO6 -> BILGE PUMP and F8 60A -> SW9 -> SO7 -> FIRE PUMP and an illegible-id 50A fuse -> SW? -> TENDER WINCH hang off the same service supply rail.

CT7 (see DWG 111a), CT8 ('to ONYX'), CT9 (WATER MAKER breaker Q26), and CT10 (AUTOPILOT PUMP breaker Q31) are current-transformer monitoring taps riding on panel breaker rows — infrastructure-level monitoring points, not separate loads.
Legend text block: CTB7 = QI-POWER-485-300-LV; CTB8 = QI-POWER-485-LV; CTB9 = QI-POWER-485-LV; CTB10 = QI-POWER-485-LV (device-type identifiers for the CT8-CT10-style taps/converters on this sheet).

Terminal block T/S E (points 5,6,7) sits inline on the EMERGENCY LTS breaker row (CB6) leading to a wire-gauge callout diamond '4'; diamond '6' near the bottom right is a wire-gauge callout on the line toward the FWD panel.
Small relay 'Re/' with contact labeled 'B&G' sits between the AFT panel breaker bank and the B&G breaker (Q47) row, at the top of the sheet — a control relay riding on the B&G supply line.
+24V EMERGENCY BATTERY feeds the Emergency Power Supply panel via CT7 (cross-ref 'see DWG 111a'); 'to ONYX' notation ties this feed toward the ONYX monitoring system off-sheet.

uncertainties: Fuse feeding TENDER WINCH has illegible device id (labeled 'F?' 50A in extraction) — read as approx. 50A, exact fuse number not legible; capture at inspection.
Switch id feeding TENDER WINCH is illegible ('SW?') — function (tender winch control switch) is clear, identifier is not.

Several right-column AFT panel breaker labels (rows around Q23-Q44) were only resolved by cross-referencing the second, more complete extraction pass; a few overlapping/duplicate Q-number reads in the raw OCR (e.g. Q24 appearing multiple times) reflect scan artifacts, not actual duplicate breakers — resolved using the clearer second table.
GMDSS sub-panel breaker CB7 6A has no legible downstream load name on this sheet (shown only as '/') — left unresolved rather than guessed.

Relay 'Re/' near the B&G breaker has a partially illegible label/rating; its function as a control relay on the B&G line is clear from the drawn line, but the coil identifier/rating could not be fully read.
CT8 destination 'to ONYX' is drawn as a cross-reference arrow off to the ONYX system; the exact wire path beyond the sheet edge is not shown here (see DWG 111a for continuation).
discarded_as_clutter: Title block repeats (DWG No., TITLE, DATE, DRAWN, PROJECT, CUSTOMER) — administrative metadata, not equipment data.
Copyright notice block — legal boilerplate, not equipment data.

Duplicate/garbled OCR rows in the raw extraction (e.g. repeated Q24, Q25, Q26 entries misattributed to later rows in the first-pass left-column table) — superseded by the clean right-column and FWD-panel tables which correctly resolve each row's label.
Grid reference row/column labels (0-9 numeric header along top of sheet) — drawing coordinate grid, not equipment.

'CB5 10A' and its unresolved '<no label visible>' rows appearing twice in different raw extraction passes — consolidated into the single CB5 -> NAV. LIGHTS reading; duplicate empty-label rows discarded.
